title_sq: Apartament 2+1 per shitje tek White Tower!
description_sq:
Ofrojme apartament 2+1 per shitje ne nje nga projektet me ambicioze te "Nova Construction 2012".
White Tower Residence eshte nje objekt drejt perfundimit ne zemer te Komunes se Parisit.
Apartamenti ndodhet ne katin e tete te objektit me orientim lindje, i organizuar ne nje sallon ndenje me ambjent gatimi, dy dhoma gjumi, dy tualete me ajrim natyral dhe nje ballkon.
Mundesi shume e mire per te jetuar ne nje ndertese elitare dhe prane te gjitha fasiliteteve qe ofron zona, aksesi me te gjitha nyjet kryesore te qytetit dhe me Liqenin e Tiranes.
Mundesi blerje post parkimi ne katin -5, me cmim ekstra!
Per me teper informacion mos hezitoni te me kontaktoni.
title_en: 2+1 apartment for sale in White Tower!
description_en: We offer a 2+1 apartment for sale in one of the most ambitious projects of "Nova Construction 2012". White Tower Residence is an object nearing completion in the heart of the Paris Commune. The apartment is located on the eighth floor of the building facing east, organized in a living room with a kitchen area, two bedrooms, two bathrooms with natural ventilation and a balcony. Very good opportunity to live in an elite building and near all the facilities that the area offers, access to all the main nodes of the city and the Lake of Tirana. Possibility to purchase a parking post on the -5th floor, at an extra price! For more information, do not hesitate to contact me.
